reason: Both have the right rule change (old DATE_NAME_TYPE replaced by TYPE_DATE_NAME, no contradiction), and both miss the Preview, Finder rename, TextEdit log order. Y covers the exceptions better. It gives the UNKNOWN-DATE prefix with the 'missing date' note, the duplicate left unrenamed with a blank new_filename and a pointer to the earlier file, the over-500 flag, and that older files were not renamed. Y also has a rename-on-disk stage, and its day count (4) is closer to the true 5 than X's 3. X has the client-types.txt lookup as a real step, timing samples and a better title and description. But X has no rename action, omits the UNKNOWN-DATE filename, and its timing summary has invented times (02:29:01 after a stated end of 02:28:25). Y's flaws are truncated description and variation text, padded open questions, and no mention of client-types.txt. Close call.
